hypothesis: A no-result MISSING_CREDENTIALS failure with a valid zero-use ledger is overwritten as an accounting failure
boundary: Only runHumanJev mocked to throw synchronously before any environment access or API; actual ledger creation/read and runner save/stop logic used
impact: Incorrect diagnostic/failure-category attribution on pre-result exceptions; phase still stops after first failure, charges zero, preserves invalid/missing slots. No demonstrated impact on completed successful trials.
minimalFix: When reserved is nonzero, retain accounting failure. Compare requests with result.apiCalls only if a result exists. For a missing result with zero ledger use, preserve the original error; for missing result with positive use, retain explicit accounting-unavailable handling. Preserve any original error as a separate cause if accounting also fails.
